title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill adds passports and driver's licences on desktop
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and the identity-document blocking policy are supported by the current Microsoft documentation. All five Learn pages flagged by the pre-check opened successfully. One minor correction remains: the checklist asks administrators to review an older policy that has no controls-table row.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; summary; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: AutofillSettings can block identity-document autofill on specified URL patterns using blocked_types containing identity_docs.
claims.quote:
Setting this policy allows you to specify which AutoFill data types are blocked on specific URL patterns.
"identity_docs": Blocks filling and saving of identity documents (for example, passports, driver's licenses, and national IDs).

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: An unconfigured AutofillSettings policy blocks no AutoFill data types by domain, and sites matching no entry are unblocked by this policy.
claims.quote:
Setting this policy allows you to specify which AutoFill data types are blocked on specific URL patterns.
If you don't configure this policy, no AutoFill data types are blocked by domain.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Blocked types from multiple matching entries are combined.
claims.quote: If a URL matches multiple pattern entries in the list, the blocked types from all matching entries are combined.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: The wildcard URL pattern * matches any URL with any scheme, port and path, allowing identity_docs to be blocked everywhere this policy applies.
claims.quote:
The wildcard * is supported and matches any URL with any scheme, port, and path.
{"blocked_types": ["identity_docs"], "url_pattern": "*"}

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Blocking a data type disables its suggestions and the prompt to save or import new data on those sites.
claims.quote: If a data type is blocked for a site, both the generation of suggestions and the prompt to save or import new data of that type are disabled on that site.
